title: Establishment of Special Courts for rape trials
verbatim_text: (1) The Federal Government, in consultation with the Chief Justice of the High Court, shall establish Special Courts to try scheduled rape and sexual assault offences with designated trial timelines of six months.
source_citation: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk) / Official Gazette, Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021

title: Prohibition of two-finger virginity test
verbatim_text: No medical examination of a female victim of a scheduled offence shall include any virginity test, hymen examination or two-finger test, which is hereby strictly prohibited and illegal.
source_citation: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk) / Official Gazette, Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021
